about_the_game:
Lost Horizon: Sky Relics invites you into a breathtaking world of floating realms, torn apart by an ancient calamity. The balance of the world is crumbling, and only the power of four legendary relics can prevent its final collapse. As the chosen hero, you must embark on a perilous journey across diverse and culturally inspired lands, uncovering secrets, mastering powerful abilities, and reclaiming what was lost.

Your adventure begins on the secluded island of Lunethra, where strange floating platforms and ancient shrines hint at a forgotten past. Guided by a radiant fairy, you’ll explore mystical landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and face formidable enemies. From the lush forests of Aeryndale to the perilous Thalora Drift, every step challenges your wits, courage, and combat prowess.

Venture deep into sky dungeons, where hidden truths and deadly trials await. Wield a variety of weapons—from swords and bows to devastating elemental magic. Adapt your fighting style with melee strikes, ranged attacks, spellcasting, and hand-thrown weapons. Master the art of observation, learning abilities directly from enemies through a unique Observe to Learn system.

The realms stand on the edge of ruin. Will you reclaim the Sky Relics, restore balance, and uncover the mystery of the Shattered Realms?

Features

🌍 Explore a Floating World – Traverse vast islands suspended in the sky, each with unique cultures, environments, and challenges.

🧩 Solve Intricate Puzzles – Test your wits with environmental challenges, elemental shrines, and cryptic dungeon mechanisms.

⚔️ Engage in Multi-Weapon Combat – Wield swords, bows, spellcasting, and hand-thrown weapons to adapt to any fight.

👁️ Observe to Learn – Watch enemies closely and replicate their abilities, unlocking new combat techniques and spells.

🗺️ Embark on an Epic Quest – Recover the four ancient relics hidden in sky dungeons to restore balance before it’s too late.

📜 Main & Side Quests – Follow the gripping main story or discover hidden side quests filled with unique characters, challenges, and rewards.

🔮 Unlock Elemental Powers – Harness fire, water, and ice magic to overcome obstacles and defeat powerful foes.

A world in ruins, an adventure beyond the clouds—will you uncover the secrets of the Lost Horizon?

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 4GB

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7 / AMD A8
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1080 8GB
